title: Rubric - Value Binding
evidence: All criteria that reference specific values bind them to authoritative sources: 'matching the corresponding expected file' binds to the ground-truth files in the verifier. 'consistent with the corresponding expected file' binds visual checks to bomb_blast_frame.png. 'the mechanic identifier from gameplay_config.txt' binds to the input file. 'the sample interval from gameplay_config.txt' binds to telemetry_sample_interval_s=1.0. 'the repeating cycle defined in gameplay_config.txt' binds to auto_cycle_interval_s=3.0. 'at least twelve seconds' comes from the prompt. No criterion references a value without tracing it to the prompt, an input file, or the expected file.
